title: Eurofighter Typhoon (Tranche 4 / LTE)

sources.title: JoyPro cockpit catalog (panels, items and grip functions of the variant)

intro: Tranche 4 is the batch of Typhoons ordered by Germany (and Spain as 'Halcon') in the 2020s, with the new electronically scanned radar from the start. Its cockpit and its stick and throttles are taken here as the same as in the earlier tranches, so the guide shows the known Typhoon cockpit. A later 'Long Term Evolution' cockpit with one large display is planned; it is not described here because no details are public yet.
